card.name: Words that precede a medium or surroundings
card.fires_on: Small positional words like middle, through, into, by, the that come just before a surrounding medium such as sea, water, or clothing. Mostly general web text about passing through or being inside something.

modes.label: Through a medium
modes.description: The word through after a verb of travel or force, before water or clothing.
modes.example: radio waves don't travel well<< through>> water, the teacher explains.

modes.label: In the middle of
modes.description: The word middle in the phrase in the middle of a body of water.
modes.example: the rock became a colorful garden in the<< middle>> of the sea.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like into, by, or the that lead into a place or surrounding.
modes.example: Isle Royale is surrounded<< by>> Lake Superior and is recognized

card.writes: It suppresses among and amid, so it steers away from group or in-the-midst words after the marked word.
card.plain: It fires on little words like through or middle that come right before a place or medium such as water or sea.
